d:
Amar and Mansi are in love, and decide to get married. Thereafter, to their joy they are blessed with a child. Then their bliss is cut short, when Amar starts to work with his advertising agency, which grooms beautiful young women. Amar’s work creates misunderstanding in his married life. How does Amar tackle his domestic life situation?
Star Cast - Rajesh Khanna, Sharmila Tagore, Dina Pathak, Dennis Clement, Satyendra Kapoor
Director - Basu Bhattacharya
Producer - Basu Bhattacharya
Music Director - Kanu Roy
Cinematographer - Nando Bhattacharya
Lyricist - Kapil Kumar, Gyandev Agnihotri
